# Business impact and criticality analysis

## Mission critical functions

The relay supports no mission critical function; analysts need reports within minutes but
field units buffer through an outage [[product/README.md]].

## Supported processes and disruption impact

BP-01, relaying field reports, has a low disruption impact and a 24-hour recovery time
requirement, and depends on the analysis enclave [[product/README.md]].

## External dependents

No external stakeholder depends on the relay's processes [[product/README.md]].

## Reevaluations

At C-2 no process's disruption impact exceeds the low availability impact, so none is
reevaluated [[product/README.md]].
